quote: We design two scenarios. The first is to have the model generate text based on recent data such as arXiv papers, news articles, new books, and Wikipedia content. An excellent model should be able to generalize these new texts with high language likelihood without data leakage. The second scenario focuses on future event prediction. An excellent model should be able to understand the current context, integrate world knowledge, and effectively generalize to future scenarios.
